evidence.title: America shut out Chinese EVs. Britain welcomed them — and now faces a difficult choice

occurrences.checkable_against: Paul Hilton's written statement to CNBC
occurrences.quote_span: "A durable UK response should pair any evidence-based trade remedy with incentives for local production, competitive energy and battery costs, charging infrastructure, skills and alignment with European market-access rules."
occurrences.speaker: Paul Hilton
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government customs tariff schedule and official statements
occurrences.quote_span: A U.K. government spokesperson reiterated to CNBC that it had not imposed tariffs on Chinese EVs
occurrences.speaker: U.K. government spokesperson
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: UK tariff schedule for imported Chinese electric vehicles
occurrences.quote_span: Chinese EVs face only a 10% standard import duty in Britain, one of the largest major overseas markets without additional China-specific tariffs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government statement on Chinese EV tariff policy
occurrences.quote_span: "We continue to engage closely with industry so that our approach reflects the sector's and UK's national interests."
occurrences.speaker: U.K. government spokesperson
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. tariff schedule for Chinese electric vehicles and import records
occurrences.quote_span: It's in contrast to the U.S., where a 100% tariff effectively shut Chinese EVs out.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: EU Made in Europe initiative rules and UK-EU trade policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: Speaking to CNBC by email, Luman said exclusion from the Made in Europe initiative could have “significant consequences” for existing businesses, making closer alignment with EU trade policy increasingly difficult to avoid.
occurrences.speaker: Rico Luman
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: European Commission tariff measures on Chinese electric vehicles
occurrences.quote_span: The European Union, the U.K.'s biggest trading partner, has manufacturer-specific duties on Chinese EVs of up to 35.3%, in addition to a standard 10% import duty on all foreign cars.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: UK Business Minister Jonathan Reynolds' policy statements and The Sunday Times report
occurrences.quote_span: At the weekend, The Sunday Times reported that U.K. Business Minister Jonathan Reynolds is considering matching the EU's levy on Chinese EVs to avoid the pain of so-called "Made in Europe" proposals, which could hurt domestic companies selling into the EU.
occurrences.speaker: The Sunday Times
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: European vehicle production, rare-earth mineral and refinery-capacity data
occurrences.quote_span: "At the same time this is logical as production in Europe isn't up to speed and Europe lacks the rare earth minerals and refinery capacity behind it," he added.
occurrences.speaker: Rico Luman
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: European Union tariff rules for batteries from China
occurrences.quote_span: "It's generally quite remarkable that batteries from China are exempted from EU tariffs," Luman said.
occurrences.speaker: Rico Luman
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: Rico Luman's written statement to CNBC and UK-EU trade policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: Rico Luman, senior sector economist for transport and logistics at ING, said the growing policy gap between Britain and the EU is leaving the U.K. with limited options, besides tariffs, if it wants to maintain a level playing field with the bloc.
occurrences.speaker: Rico Luman
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: Paul Hilton's written statement to CNBC and UK vehicle registration data
occurrences.quote_span: "Tariffs aimed only at Chinese-built battery EVs could slow one part of the expansion, but would not address hybrid growth, vehicles made outside China or the underlying advantages in cost, product cadence and supply chains," Hilton said.
occurrences.speaker: Paul Hilton
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles

occurrences.checkable_against: EU legislative proposal and UK government tariff policy
occurrences.quote_span: Now, the U.K. faces a difficult choice, as EU proposals may force it to impose tariffs to match the bloc's.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.K. tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles
